SELECT * FROM worklist order by worklist_regidate desc limit #{graterthanonepage},12;

SELECT w.work_id, w.title, w.content, w.user_code, w.onedayclass_num, w.created_at, wi.image_url AS thumbnail_url FROM work w LEFT JOIN work_image wi ON w.work_id = wi.work_id AND wi.is_thumbnail = TRUE WHERE w.work_id = #{work_id};

SELECT wc.comment_id, wc.work_id, wc.parent_id, wc.user_code, wc.content, wc.created_at, wc.updated_at FROM work_comment wc WHERE wc.work_id = #{work_id} ORDER BY wc.created_at ASC, wc.comment_id ASC LIMIT 100 OFFSET #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_comment ( work_id, user_code, parent_id, content, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{workId}, #{userCode}, #{parentId}, #{comment}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
